These files are served locally. Run `npm ci` then `npm run build:vendor`
to reproduce the JavaScript assets from package-lock.json.

- HTMX 2.0.11: https://github.com/bigskysoftware/htmx (0BSD, htmx/LICENSE).
- Alpine.js and Alpine Focus 3.17.4: https://github.com/alpinejs/alpine
  (MIT, alpine/LICENSE.md applies to both packages).

The Alpine license is retained here because its npm distributions omit it.
